dengpao.instruction: Raise the left arm and hold the lamp stand steady. Move the right hand to the light bulb, unscrew it, and place it in the box on the right.

diguan.instruction: Use the left hand to pick up the test tube from the rack and the right hand to pick up the dropper from the bottle. Move the dropper above the test tube opening, then squeeze it to drop liquid into the test tube.

yifu.instruction: Raise the right arm and take the clothes off the hanger. Then raise the left arm and use the right hand to place the clothes over the left arm.

drink.instruction: Use the left hand to pick up a cup and the right hand to press the drink dispenser tap to fill it. Then turn around, use the right hand to pick up the ice scoop and add ice to the cup, and finally place the cup back on the table.
